Flight FR2847 from Barcelona to Manchester was delayed by 3 hours and 20 minutes due to a technical issue with the aircraft. Passengers were informed at the gate and provided with meal vouchers. If your flight was delayed by more than 3 hours, you may be entitled to compensation under EU Regulation 261/2004. Our automated claims tool can check your eligibility in under a minute. Visit our website and enter your booking reference to get started.

We recommend keeping your receipts for any expenses incurred during the delay. You can submit these along with your claim. The entire process is handled online, and you'll receive a response within 14 days.

For urgent inquiries, contact our customer service team. Please have your booking details ready. Note that we will never ask for your password or payment details via email.
